relevance_rank_note: Direct test of B in neurons: surface biotinylation of Apoer2 and glutamate receptors after exogenous ApoE4 vs ApoE3, but the cells are mouse cortical neurons (not astrocytes), ApoE is added exogenously, and ARF6 is never examined.

description: Primary mouse cortical neurons were exposed to Reelin plus exogenous ApoE isoforms for 2 h and surface Apoer2 was measured by surface biotinylation; surface/total Apoer2 was lower with ApoE4 than with ApoE3 (bars about 25% vs about 51% of control, i.e. roughly half of the ApoE3 level; effect expressed as ApoE4 relative to ApoE3, read off the figure).
quote: ApoE3 was marginally, but not significantly, more effective than ApoE2, whereas ApoE4 led to a dramatic and statistically highly significant reduction of Apoer2 at the neuronal cell surface.
summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, + Reelin) -> (less surface Apoer2, total Apoer2 normalised)
system: Primary embryonic cortical neurons from wild-type mice, DIV 12-13; human ApoE2/E3/E4 lipoproteins secreted by stably transfected HEK293 cells, 3 ug/mL, co-incubated with Reelin 2 ug/mL for 2 h at 37 C; cell-surface biotinylation, neutravidin pull-down, anti-Apoer2 immunoblot, surface/total ratio. Deviation: mouse neurons not human astrocytes, in vitro embryonic culture, exogenous ApoE on a mouse-ApoE-free background, ligand-stimulated (Reelin) endocytosis condition.
human_check: Effect read from bar heights (ApoE3+R ~51, ApoE4+R ~25 % of control). P is the ** bracket between ApoE3+R and ApoE4+R; legend key **P<0.01. Legend for C says 'quantitated as described in B' (B = four independent experiments) but does not state n for C explicitly.

description: Primary mouse cortical neurons were exposed to exogenous ApoE isoforms for 15 min (no Reelin) and surface Apoer2 was measured by surface biotinylation; ApoE4 lowered surface/total Apoer2 while ApoE3 did not differ from control (bars about 63% vs about 83% of control, ApoE4 roughly 24% below ApoE3, read off the figure).
quote: Whereas ApoE2 (lane 2) and ApoE3 (lane 3) did not reduce surface expression of Apoer2 compared with the control (lane 1), ApoE4 significantly decreased surface expression of this “dual function” Reelin and ApoE receptor (lane 4)
summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (less surface Apoer2, total Apoer2 normalised)
system: Primary embryonic cortical neurons from wild-type mice, DIV 12-13; human ApoE2/E3/E4 lipoproteins secreted by stably transfected HEK293 cells, 3 ug/mL for 15 min at 37 C; cell-surface biotinylation with membrane-impermeable biotin, neutravidin pull-down, anti-Apoer2 immunoblot normalised to total Apoer2. Deviation: mouse neurons not human astrocytes, in vitro embryonic culture, exogenous ApoE, short exposure.
human_check: Effect read from bar heights (ApoE3 ~83, ApoE4 ~63 % of control) and expressed relative to ApoE3. P is the * bracket ApoE3 vs ApoE4 (legend key *P<0.05, unpaired t test); the ** on the ApoE4 bar is vs control.

description: Surface NMDA receptor subunit GluN2B (surface/total, surface biotinylation) in Reelin-stimulated primary neurons was lower after ApoE4 than after ApoE3 preincubation (bars about 18% vs about 65% of control; ApoE4 roughly 72% below ApoE3, read off the figure).
quote: (H and I) ApoE4 reduces GluA1, GluA2/3, and GluN2B cell-surface levels in acutely Reelin stimulated primary neurons.
system: Primary embryonic mouse cortical neurons, DIV 12-13; preincubated with HEK293-secreted human ApoE2/E3/E4 (3 ug/mL per Fig 2 protocol) then acutely stimulated with Reelin; surface biotinylation and immunoblot, surface/total protein standardised to control. Deviation: mouse neurons not human astrocytes, in vitro embryonic culture, exogenous ApoE, Reelin-stimulated.

description: Pulse-chase of internalised ApoE in primary neurons: after suramin strip of surface ApoE, ApoE4 was released into the medium more slowly and more ApoE4 stayed intracellular than ApoE3 over 30-120 min, i.e. the ligand itself recycles poorly (a surrogate for receptor recycling, not a receptor measurement).
quote: Substantially more ApoE4 was retained in intracellular compartments at all time points, confirming that impaired recycling of ApoE4 also occurs in primary neurons.
system: Primary embryonic mouse cortical neurons, DIV 12-13; HEK293-secreted human ApoE2/E3/E4 3 ug/mL, 15-30 min uptake at 37 C, suramin wash, chase 30/60/120 min; ApoE immunoprecipitated from medium and lysate, immunoblot. Deviation: mouse neurons not human astrocytes, in vitro, exogenous ApoE; measures ligand recycling not receptor recycling.
human_check: Single representative blot, no quantification. Text says 15 min incubation, legend says 30 min.
